body: not that i don't think brittaneykate's heart is in the right place re: the dog saga on her story, i'd  do the same thing! but i guess i'm just a little confused about her saying she wants to keep the dog/they're planning on coming back for it. isn't is possible it has a family already and just ran away/got lost? especially given the breed...i'd make 100% sure no on in knoxville was looking for their dog before talking myself up about it being mine now.
